audit_metadata.title: go-On AI Face Attendance System - Deep UI/UX Audit & Layout Alignment Results

audit_summary.executive_overview: Comprehensive end-to-end UI/UX audit, layout defect remediation, and responsive design optimization across the go-On mobile application, desktop Flutter web interface, and FastAPI admin management console. All confirmed UI misalignments, Dismissible tree mutation crashes, table action wrapping bugs, metric grid imbalances, and missing CSS utility classes were remediated, verified with automated tests, and validated on the physical Samsung Galaxy S24 device.

issues.description: Orphaned remote settings icon (Icons.settings_remote_rounded) rendered in AppBar while server configuration was already cleanly provided via in-canvas status pill.
issues.root_cause: Redundant action widget remaining in AppBar after unified ServerConnectionStatusPill was embedded in main form canvas.
issues.fix_applied: Removed orphaned IconButton from AppBar actions while retaining full server configuration capabilities within the interactive canvas status pill.

responsive_verification.mobile_portrait: PASS - Clean, centered card layout with no top bar clutter
responsive_verification.tablet_landscape: PASS - Constrained max-width container (480px) preventing stretched fields
responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - Verified on localhost:3000 with centered elevation and dark theme

issues.description: Dismissible tree crash: 'A dismissed Dismissible widget is still part of the tree' when swiping to pin or delete.
issues.root_cause: Dismissible confirmDismiss callback triggered asynchronous state listeners and widget tree rebuilds during the dismiss swipe animation, causing render tree mismatch.
issues.fix_applied: For swipe-right (pin/unpin): return false immediately to snap card back smoothly and defer toggle logic to WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback. For swipe-left (delete): synchronously remove item from NotificationService local tracking set before returning true.

issues.description: Deleted notifications reappearing upon pull-to-refresh or background polling.
issues.root_cause: NotificationService fetched complete list from backend without tracking locally dismissed notification IDs in client cache.
issues.fix_applied: Added _deletedNotificationIds set to NotificationService; filtered out any deleted IDs across all fetchNotifications calls and locally cached states.

issues.description: Pinned notification state lost on screen re-entry.
issues.root_cause: Lack of client-side pinned IDs preservation set during API response hydration.
issues.fix_applied: Implemented _pinnedNotificationIds set in NotificationService with deterministic top-sorting comparator.

responsive_verification.mobile_portrait: PASS - Verified on Samsung Galaxy S24 with fluid swipe gestures
responsive_verification.tablet_landscape: PASS - Dismissible cards stretch smoothly with responsive padding
responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - Mouse drag and keyboard accessibility operational

issues.description: Dashboard metrics grid was unbalanced (odd columns, overflowing right gutter on widescreen displays).
issues.root_cause: CSS grid-template-columns had variable minmax causing uneven row wraps (3 cards on row 1, 1 on row 2).
issues.fix_applied: Configured .metrics-grid to repeat(4, 1fr) with auto-fit breakpoints, forming a structured 4x2 metrics matrix on desktop and 2x4 on mobile/tablet.

issues.description: Default browser scrollbars were bright white, clashing with dark console theme.
issues.root_cause: Missing custom scrollbar styling in global admin CSS.
issues.fix_applied: Engineered sleek dark scrollbars using ::-webkit-scrollbar (6px width, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) thumb) and Firefox scrollbar-width: thin.

responsive_verification.mobile_portrait: PASS - 1-2 column responsive stacking without horizontal clipping
responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - 4-column balanced 4x2 matrix with full contrast

screen_audit_details.automated_test: Live browser rendering verified via Playwright screenshot capture

issues.description: Table action buttons wrapped onto multiple lines in narrow columns, misaligning rows.
issues.root_cause: Action container lacked white-space: nowrap and inline-flex alignment.
issues.fix_applied: Enforced .btn-group { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 4px; } with standardized 30x30px square buttons and vertically centered icons.

issues.description: 25+ missing utility classes in admin HTML causing fallback unstyled text and badges.
issues.root_cause: HTML templates referenced utility classes (.flex, .items-center, .gap-1, .p-3, .p-4, .table-pagination, .alert-*) that were omitted from admin_style.css.
issues.fix_applied: Added full utility class suite with comprehensive flexbox, spacing, typography, and alert styles.

responsive_verification.mobile_portrait: PASS - Horizontal scroll wrapper (.table-responsive) prevents viewport breakage
responsive_verification.tablet_landscape: PASS - Full table visibility with compact padding
responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - Fixed column headers, aligned actions, 100% table layout

issues.description: Audit log entries rendered as raw unformatted list items with unconstrained metadata JSON strings.
issues.root_cause: No CSS rules for .audit-list-compact and .audit-item containers.
issues.fix_applied: Implemented dark card styling for .audit-item with accent blue action pills, mono-spaced timestamp formatting, and word-break wrapping.

responsive_verification.tablet_landscape: PASS - Multi-attribute inline layout with badge accents
responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - Compact scrollable audit feed with 350px max height

issues.description: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed encountered when calling /api/v1/notifications/{id}/pin and unpin.
issues.root_cause: Stale background daemon running on port 8000 without latest router changes.
issues.fix_applied: Terminated stale process, refreshed router definitions, verified all POST and DELETE routes return HTTP 200 OK with accurate payloads.

responsive_verification.desktop_web: PASS - Localhost CORS and authorization headers confirmed
